about_the_game:
New year, new you

Your freshman year was everything you dreamed of.
Sex, parties, friendship… maybe even love.

But then summer hit.
You reconnected with your estranged, terminally ill father—only to watch him die.
Overwhelmed with regret, guilt, and anger, you ghosted everyone.

Now, a month late, you're back at San Vallejo College.
But nothing's the same.

Welcome to another year of wild parties, brutal fights, and hot sex – only now it's laced with dark secrets, gut-wrenching choices, and emotional fallout.

Welcome to your sophomore year. 

Boys fight, men lead

The college's underground fight tournaments have evolved into a national league and your new dean wants you to lead the college's brand new fight club.

You're no longer just one of the boys, you're the boss.

What used to be your friends, are now your fighters. And what used to be your free time is now your office hours. Train different fighting styles, make tough decisions and pick who gets to show the world what he's got, and who's getting benched.

The success of San Vallejo College is in your hands –
and everyone’s watching what you’ll do with that power.

Lust without limits

This year, campus is filled with beautiful women competing for power, status, and your attention.

Old flames want to reignite what you once had, while ambitious freshmen are shaking up the social order — clawing their way to the top, and into your bed.

Whether you build a loving, committed relationship with your girlfriend… or sneak off at 3 am to hook up with her 18-year-old sister. Whether you bounce between flings or build a no-rules harem where you wake up next to three naked girls tangled in your sheets. Whether you chase the one, or leave her hanging to break taboos with your professor — you can have anything you want, as long as you're willing to pay the price.

A fresh start — for you, and for the series.

College Kings 3 is a full standalone story — no need to play the earlier games to dive right in. With new characters, branching arcs, and a full fight club management system that shapes the story, this isn’t just a continuation. It’s a bold new direction.

Returning fan? You'll find familiar faces (don’t worry — Chloe and Nora are still here), deeper arcs, and the ability to carry over key choices from your freshman year to unlock secret sex scenes and exclusive moments.

Power. Pleasure. Consequences.

College Kings 3 is entirely written by the original creator, Undergrad Steve.

It’s an emotionally charged story about leadership, morality, and what happens when the lines between lust, love, and ambition start to blur.

Expect impossible choices with soul-crushing consequences, shifting loyalties, and a spotlight that never turns off.

And yes — it’s also packed with explicit, cinematic sex scenes that are as diverse, wild, and taboo-breaking as the story itself. Nothing's off-limits.

Wishlist now.

content_descriptors.notes:
College Kings 3 contains sexual depictions, violence and drug references. Not intended for audiences under 18 years old. 
All sex in the game is consensual and all characters are over 18 years old.
